sentences.en: Disaster puts one in touch with oneself: suffering fuels creativity.
sentences.zh: 灾难让人与自我产生联结：苦难激发创造力。

sentences.en: Yanni needs to unleash the full weight of his creativity.
sentences.zh: 亚尼需要释放他全部的创造力。

sentences.en: Lack of inspiration is the worst enemy of creativity.
sentences.zh: 缺乏灵感是创造力的最大敌人。

senses.zh: 创造性，创造力，创作能力
